frozen_before: any returned file is read; the collector owns the data, this audit makes no network request
independence: the audit recomputes windows, identities, completion status, budgets and the summary from controls.json and the returned files with its own code and imports nothing from window_count.py
inputs: a returned directory containing exactly results.json, receipt.json, requests.json; pinned controls.json and protocol.json from the admitted archive 4b0e6af5…
not_done: no network, no re-read of any endpoint, no reanalysis of fragments
observations_not_judged: positives with zero fragments in a library
verdict: consistent if every check passes, else inconsistent; consistent means the returned files agree with the frozen protocol and each other, not that the biology is right and not that the counts are validated against an independent measurement
